name: Avocado oil
description: Refined or unrefined, as sold for cooking.

salicylates.note: Avocado fruit is rated high or very high; the oil is not listed.

oxalates.note: No measurement found; refined oils are not listed in the sources used.

amines.note: One list rates avocado oil very high without a measurement; refined oils carry little protein and no measured data was found.

histamine.note: Avocado fruit is scored 2 (H L); the oil is not listed.

evidence.basis: 0.64 µg per 10 g, 11 samples; about 0.9 µg at 14 g
